How do I use it properly the very first time?
For the Wax Melt Discovery Starter Kit with the Mod warmer, here’s a simple first run:
Set the warmer on a level, safe surface. Keep its cord from hanging over an edge or touching a hot surface.
Put the silicone dish on top, then add 2–3 wax bears to the dish. Don’t add water or oil.
Plug in the warmer and choose a timer setting. Our Mod warmer guide says to press the Power Timer button twice for 3 hours, three times for 6 hours, or four times for 9 hours. For your first try, 3 hours is a simple place to start.
When you’re done, let the wax cool and harden completely before lifting the dish and popping it out. Don’t pour used wax down the drain.
Follow the instructions included with your warmer, too.
